c1.note: Dow's leadership page lists Andre Argenton as Chief Technology & Sustainability Officer; the SEC 8-K and Trellis confirm he took over the CTO role from Sreeram.

c3.note: The official title is the combined 'Chief Technology & Sustainability Officer', as shown on his profile page.

c4.note: The 8-K states he was appointed Chief Technology and Sustainability Officer effective January 1, 2026.

c5.note: The 8-K says Sreeram 'will be succeeded by Andre Argenton'.

c7.note: The 8-K states Sreeram gave notice on December 29, 2025 of retirement effective June 30, 2026.

c8.note: Trellis does say he retired effective Jan 1, which conflicts with the 8-K's June 30 date; the claim accurately attributes the statement to Trellis.

c11.note: The 8-K says he most recently served as Chief Sustainability Officer and VP of EH&S.

c14.note: The 8-K says he brings over 25 years at Dow, including senior R&D leadership roles.

c15.note: Trellis says he joined Dow Brazil in 1999; Dow's profile also gives 1999.

c16.note: The 8-K says Argenton will lead Dow's global R&D organization (and continue to lead EHS&S); Dow's leadership page confirms it. Variants E, C and F are all supported.

c17.note: The 8-K says he continues to lead the environment, health, safety and sustainability organization; Dow's profile confirms he is responsible for it. This is context about his role, not the CTO answer itself.

c18.note: Dow's profile page states he is responsible for leading the global R&D organization, Sustainability and Environmental Health and Safety. Variants E, A and D match its wording.

c19.note: TradingView lists the SEC filing as the 8-K of Jan. 05, 2026. The filing covers the Argenton appointment, so both variants hold. This is provenance, not the answer.

c20.note: Sreeram gave notice of retirement on Dec 29, 2025. The public announcement was in the Jan 5, 2026 8-K, so the December 29 date is when notice was given, not the announcement. This is a minor imprecision, and it is background rather than the answer.
